spells/spellsong-lesser-330.effectSummary: Functions as spellsong but can prepare only one spell of 1st level or lower in this spell's slot. The chosen spell must otherwise satisfy spellsong's normal preparation and component rules, including the mandatory verbal component when it is cast.

spells/slow-consumption-218.name: Slow Consumption
spells/slow-consumption-218.effectSummary: Cast on a helpless living creature in a desecrated or unhallowed area. For each day you touch the subject, you heal naturally at twice the normal rate and need not eat, while the subject does not heal naturally and takes 1 Constitution damage. If more than 24 hours pass without the daily touch, the spell ends.

spells/soul-shackles-219.name: Soul Shackles
spells/soul-shackles-219.effectSummary: Draws the soul of a dead creature into a talisman the subject possessed when it died. While you possess the talisman, you can call forth the soul for up to 1 round per caster level each day and ask one question per round; answers are clear, complete, and precise. A hostile soul, or one asked an important secret, gets a Will save; success ends the spell and releases the soul. Focus: the talisman. Location component: a desecrated or unhallowed area.

spells/identify-transgressor-157.name: Identify Transgressor
spells/identify-transgressor-157.effectSummary: Answers one 'who?' question whose answer can be a single person's name. The base chance of a correct answer is 70% +1% per caster level, subject to DM adjustment for unusual circumstances or anti-divination precautions. You normally know if the result is incorrect unless false-information magic intervenes. Repeated castings by the same caster about the same question use the same die result. Drug component: vodare; location component: a desecrated or unhallowed area.

spells/zealot-pact-713.name: Zealot Pact
spells/zealot-pact-713.effectSummary: Creates a permanent-until-triggered pact on one willing living creature. It activates when the target successfully hits a foe whose alignment is exactly opposite the deity's, then for 1 round per caster level grants +4 on melee attacks, double melee damage, automatic confirmation of critical hits, and alignment descriptors matching the deity. The target is compelled to attack opposite-aligned foes if able and knows which creatures within 60 feet qualify. Only one zealot pact can affect a creature. XP cost: 500.

spells/sphere-of-ultimate-destruction-47.name: Sphere of Ultimate Destruction
spells/sphere-of-ultimate-destruction-47.effectSummary: Creates a 2-foot-radius black sphere for 1 round per caster level that flies up to 30 feet per round. You direct it to a target; in this printing it requires a ranged touch attack. A hit deals 2d6 damage per caster level, maximum 40d6, and a successful Fortitude save reduces this to 5d6. A creature reduced to 0 or fewer hp is disintegrated; against objects it can disintegrate up to one 10-foot cube of nonliving matter. Its effect counts as disintegrate against wall of force and similar effects. Material component: dust from a disintegrated creature.

spells/steal-life-220.name: Steal Life
spells/steal-life-220.effectSummary: While you concentrate, drains 1 point from one ability score of the subject each round, rotating among all six abilities before the same score can be drained again. On the night of a full moon, each point drained makes you effectively one week younger; otherwise only the subject suffers the drain. When the subject's Constitution reaches 0 it becomes a dry husk and cannot be drained further. If you die while concentrating, all ability points lost to the spell immediately return. Location component: a desecrated or unhallowed area.

spells/sword-of-deception-2078.name: Sword of Deception
spells/sword-of-deception-2078.effectSummary: Creates a pale green force blade for 1 round per caster level. It attacks a designated foe using the BAB of a fighter whose level equals your caster level, deals 1d4 damage, threatens on 19–20, and can make multiple attacks on later rounds when that BAB permits. Each hit imposes -1 luck on the target's next dangerous saving throw, or -2 on a critical hit, cumulative to -5; remove curse or similar magic can end the penalty. Switching targets is a standard action. The blade cannot be attacked or damaged and checks spell resistance only on its first strike against a creature. Focus: a miniature sword and loaded dice.
spells/sword-of-deception-2078.notes: Manually source-reviewed and digest-locked. Batch 115 stays deliberately small and groups related printing families so inheritance is closed within the review boundary.

spells/sword-of-darkness-2095.name: Sword of Darkness
spells/sword-of-darkness-2095.effectSummary: Creates a blade of negative energy for 1 round per caster level. It attacks at your base attack bonus and otherwise follows the source printing's autonomous sword behavior: it can make later full attacks against the same target, switches targets when directed, cannot be attacked or damaged, and checks spell resistance on first contact. Each hit bestows one negative level; a 19–20 critical bestows two. A living creature with negative levels at least equal to its HD dies; surviving negative levels fade after hours equal to caster level. Against undead, a hit instead grants 5 temporary hp per two caster levels, maximum 25, for 1 hour. Material component: a katana or longsword worth at least 100 gp, shattered during casting.
spells/sword-of-darkness-2095.notes: Manually source-reviewed and digest-locked. Batch 115 stays deliberately small and groups related printing families so inheritance is closed within the review boundary.
